name: Notes
description: Post-it notes on the canvas: a note shows a title and a short text, written in simple markdown (headings, bullets, bold, and https links), on a background color of its own. Notes run nothing and connect to nothing. The Researcher agent writes its findings into them.

templates.label: Note
templates.description: A post-it note: its title, and its text as simple markdown (headings, bullets, bold, https links) on its own background color (appearance.backgroundColor: yellow, pink, blue, green, orange, lavender, or #rrggbb). Presentation only: it has no inputs or outputs and a run skips it.
